title: Yellow Explosive Boy
description: Four comic-style illustrations of a muscular blond boy in a yellow and black armored suit with glowing yellow energy effects. He is shown in dynamic action poses: generating yellow energy bursts from his fists, running with motion trails, punching forward with an intense explosive blast of light and shards, and standing in a ready stance.
prompt: A comic book character sheet of a tough blond boy with spiky hair wearing a black and yellow armored suit with glowing yellow accents. He has a determined angry expression with furrowed brows. Multiple dynamic action poses showing him generating bright yellow explosive energy from his fists, running with motion effects, delivering a powerful forward punch that creates a massive yellow energy blast with flying shards, and standing in a combat stance, dramatic lighting, detailed digital painting
